name: breakpoints
summary: Four mutually-exclusive viewport bands — SM, MD, LG, XL — each owning a closed media-query range. The canonical viewport per band is the single representative width used by the Storybook viewport addon and Figma canvas frames. Encoded as primitive Figma `Number` Variables (`breakpoint/<bp>`) and CSS custom properties (`--breakpoint-<bp>`).

tokens.$description: dual-purpose: SM canonical viewport; SM band has no CSS lower bound (uses `max-width: 767px`)
dual-purpose: MD media-query lower threshold AND canonical viewport
dual-purpose: LG media-query lower threshold AND canonical viewport
dual-purpose: XL media-query lower threshold AND canonical viewport
